method: First pass manually inspecting CISI1 primary plate images before opening selected Mayig or Lipi sign sequences. Notes describe broad shapes in impression visual left-to-right order. These are qualitative observations; internal hatching counts and composite segmentation require catalogue adjudication. This is an AI visual audit, not expert palaeographic verification.
